description: Comprehensive monitoring dashboard for rstmdb - a distributed state machine database. Includes request metrics, latency percentiles, error rates, WAL I/O, and system resources.

panels.description: Number of replicas currently connected to the primary.
panels.title: Connected Replicas

panels.description: Replica's lag in entries behind primary (replica-side view).
panels.title: Max Replica Lag (entries)

panels.description: Replica's time-based lag behind primary (replica-side view).
panels.title: Max Replica Lag (seconds)

panels.description: Rate of WAL entries the primary is streaming to all replicas.
panels.title: Replication Throughput

panels.description: Cumulative sync replication timeouts. Non-zero values indicate replicas are slow or disconnected in sync mode.
panels.title: Sync Timeouts

panels.description: Cumulative count of replicas disconnected by the primary due to a full send channel (slow replica). Non-zero indicates backpressure.
panels.title: Slow-Replica Disconnects

panels.description: Per-replica lag in entries (primary-side view). Each line is one replica.
panels.title: Per-Replica Lag (entries)

panels.description: Replica lag over time (replica-side view, labeled by scrape instance).
panels.title: Replica Lag Over Time

panels.description: Last-acked WAL sequence per replica (primary-side view).
panels.title: Per-Replica Last-Acked Sequence

panels.description: WAL entries streamed to replicas per second.
panels.title: Replication Throughput & Sync Timeouts
